<USER_REQUEST>
I am building Home, About, Contact & Delivery for "The Sweet Oven", a home bakery website
  (group project, theme: Home bakery). The repository is already set up.
  Read the project folder first and tell me what exists.

  Rules:
  * Use only HTML5, CSS3 and vanilla JavaScript. Bootstrap:yes, Use Bootstrap 5 via CDN for CSS only. Do not use Bootstrap's JavaScript. Write all interactions in vanilla JavaScript.,  No other frameworks, no
  jQuery.
  * Use the existing shared files: css/style.css, and the shared header and footer from the shared layer. Do not edit other members' pages or the shared CSS. Put my page styles in css/[my-page].css.
  * Put JavaScript in js/, images in images/. Use relative links only.
  * Use semantic tags (header, nav, main, footer), alt text on every image, labels on every form field.
  * Realistic content only: real item names and prices in PKR. No lorem ipsum.
  * Page content must be generated from JavaScript data (arrays in js/) wherever it is a list.
  * Handle edge cases: empty states, invalid input, no results.
  * Save state with localStorage where it should survive a reload.
  * Responsive: desktop and mobile, a hamburger menu on small screens.
  * Colours: cream #FFF8EE, brown #4A2C1D, caramel #B5601E, pink #F3B6C0.


  My duties are:
   *Pages:* Home, About, Contact & Delivery
   *Data and Display:* Best Sellers from an array
   *Forms and Input:* Contact form with validation
   *State and Memory:* Remembered visit or theme
   *Interaction:* Best-Sellers Carousel
   *Logic and Calculations:* Delivery fee by Area
   *Responsiveness and accessibility:* Hamburger Menu, Focus Statesaudit but the thing is that it needs to be similar to prototype so i'll explain that to you. Here is the poster broken down in plain language: Three desktop pages: Home, About the baker, Contact and
  deliver, mobile view, interactive component: the Delivery checker, shown in 4 states. It lives on the Contact page and should work the same on mobile.Page 1: HomeLarge heading: "Fresh cakes!"
  Pink "Order Now" button, which goes to the Menu.
  "Best Sellers" heading.
  Three product cards in a row. Each has a cake-slice image and a pink "Add" button. Clicking Add increases the cart count by 1, so Cart (0) becomes Cart (1).
  A row of three small round icons with a caption line under each: cupcake, cake slice and delivery truck. The mobile view shows the captions as "Baked daily", "Custom cakes" and "Home delivery".
  Footer strip.Page 2: About the baker
  Heading: "Meet the baker."
  A chef-hat image on the left with a few lines of bio text on the right.
  Heading: "How we bake."
  Three square boxes joined by arrows (step 1 → step 2 → step 3). Each is a step in the baking process, with an icon or short label.
  Pink "See our menu" button, which goes to the Menu.
  Footer strip.Page 3: Contact and delivery
  Heading: "Send us a message."
  A form with three single-line inputs (for example name, email and subject) and one large message box.
  Pink "Send" button. It shows either "Message sent" or an error, depending on whether the form is valid.
  A divider, then the Delivery checker: a dropdown reading "Select area" and a "Check" button, with a result line underneath.
  Footer strip.Mobile Home (vertical prototype)
  The header has the logo circle and "Bakery" on the left and a hamburger icon on the right, which opens the Menu. The Cart button isn't shown here, so decide where cart access goes on mobile.
  Below it, in one stacked column: "Fresh cakes!", a large cake image, a full-width pink "Order Now" button, and a rounded card with three icon rows (Baked daily, Custom cakes, Home delivery).
  Footer: "Open: Mon to Sun, 8am to 8pm."
  Best Sellers isn't shown on mobile, so it's either hidden or below the fold.                          It doesn't need to be exactly like the prototype but it should be similar
